name: Amahoshi Yuina
source:
Hobbies: Making sweets
Likes: Drawing, love stories, pancakes
Dislikes: Talent, people who aren't serious about their work, cats

A girl who's a year younger than [url=/c98086]Toshiki's[/url] who enters the CG & Illustration department at Saika Private Academy. She is quite frivolous and has a sly streak as well. Despite this, Yuina is also very serious when it comes to drawing, and always makes sure to keep up both the quality and with the deadlines.

[Based on the [url=http://ainolinks.com/]official website[/url]]
